newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sends aid to Iran, but rescue team on hold.
newsitem.headline: France sends aid to Iran, but rescue team on hold.

text.p: France on Tuesday dropped plans to send a 30-strong rescue team to help survivors in quake-stricken Iran after Tehran declined the offer, the Foreign Ministry said.
"After a new evaluation of the situation by the Iranian authorities...the arrival of foreign rescuers no longer seemed necessary," Foreign Ministry spokesman Yves Doutriaux said.
He said Paris would instead send a new aeroplane loaded with several tonnes of emergency supplies to Iran, where the death toll was revised down on Tuesday to 1,560 dead and 2,810 injured.
France sent a first plane with 39 tonnes of emergency equipment and medicine on Saturday.

The Foreign Ministry had announced on Monday it would send the rescuers, backed by sniffer dogs, in a bid to find survivors in the rubble after Saturday's quake in eastern Iran, with a force of 7.1 on the Richter scale.
